name: pixoo-mcp-server
description: Render and push styled pixel art, text, dashboards, and animations to Divoom Pixoo LED displays.

pixoo_ip.title: Pixoo Device IP
pixoo_ip.description: IP address of your Pixoo display on the local network (e.g. 192.168.1.50). Required for device tools. Run pixoo_discover_devices to find it.

pixoo_size.title: Pixoo Display Size
pixoo_size.description: Display size in pixels: 16, 32, or 64. Must match your physical device. Defaults to 64 (Pixoo-64).

pixoo_output_dir.title: Preview Output Directory
pixoo_output_dir.description: Directory where render tools save preview PNG and GIF files. Leave blank to return previews only in the tool response.

pixoo_push_min_interval_ms.title: Minimum Push Interval (ms)
pixoo_push_min_interval_ms.description: Minimum gap between device pushes, in milliseconds, so rapid pushes don't freeze the device. Defaults to 1000.

pixoo_serve_host.title: Animation Serve Host
pixoo_serve_host.description: Host the device downloads animations of more than 40 frames from, for NAT or a DNS name. Leave blank to use this computer's address on the network that reaches the device.

pixoo_serve_port.title: Animation Serve Port
pixoo_serve_port.description: Fixed port for the device's animation download, for firewall rules. Leave blank to pick a free port each time.

pixoo_browser_path.title: Browser Path
pixoo_browser_path.description: Path to a chrome-headless-shell executable for HTML rendering, such as the one `npx @puppeteer/browsers install chrome-headless-shell@stable --path <dir>` installs. Leave blank to use the newest chrome-headless-shell in Puppeteer's cache (~/.cache/puppeteer).

pixoo_html_enabled.title: HTML Rendering
pixoo_html_enabled.description: Set to false to turn off the pixoo_render_html tool. Leave blank to keep it on.
